description: Cuzom's shared Renovate settings: dependency updates. Use them with: "extends": ["github>cuzom-dev/dev-config"]. This repository is public on purpose - Renovate gives a public repository a token scoped to that repository alone, so a public repository cannot read a preset that lives in a private one.

packageRules.description: Node.js waits longer than the 3-day hold so version managers (mise, asdf) have caught up
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI passes

Every action update except a major one comes as one pull request, so the workflows' digests cost one CI run a week instead of one per action. Container images in a workflow are not actions, so a repository can keep grouping its Playwright image with @playwright/test.
Major updates need approval on the Dependency Dashboard and a manual merge

A plain typescript dependency waits for typescript-eslint before going to 7 (8.74 still declares typescript <6.1.0). A repository whose type checking runs tsc takes TypeScript 7 now through an alias instead: "typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2" for the tools and "@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@^7.0.2" for tsc. matchPackageNames matches the package looked up on the registry and matchDepNames the name in package.json, so this rule needs both to be typescript and never matches the alias: the aliased typescript follows @typescript/typescript6, which has no 7, and @typescript/native is already on 7, so its minor and patch updates merge like any other. Without the alias (vue-tsc and nuxi typecheck need TypeScript's JS API, which 7 lacks), the TypeScript 7 pull request stays open with a note instead of waiting for approval, and Renovate does not rebase it on its own (rebaseWhen is conflicted). Once typescript-eslint supports 7, the alias goes: typescript becomes ^7 and @typescript/native is removed. The rule only matches below 7, so it retires itself.
prBodyNotes: **Do not merge yet.** TypeScript 7 waits until typescript-eslint supports it: 8.74 still declares `typescript <6.1.0` and stops with "typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0". In a repository that uses `@cuzom/eslint-config`, it also needs a dev-config release that allows TypeScript 7. If this repository's type checking runs `tsc`, take TypeScript 7 now through the alias instead, `"typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2"` beside `"@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@^7.0.2"` (the handbook's `tech-stack.md`), and close this pull request. If it runs `vue-tsc` or `nuxi typecheck`, keep this pull request open: closing it tells Renovate to ignore TypeScript 7. Once typescript-eslint supports 7, tick the rebase box below: Renovate rebases a pull request only when it conflicts, so CI does not run again on its own.
